title: The first thing to find in your new house

scenes.text: The first thing to find in your new house
scenes.label: NEW HOMEOWNERS

scenes.text: When a pipe bursts, water comes out at several gallons a minute.
The difference between a $300 repair and a $30,000 insurance claim is how fast you can stop it.
A $5 tag on the shutoff vs. ten minutes of water pouring through your ceiling.

caption.hook: The first thing to find in your new house isn’t the Wi-Fi password.
caption.feel: Nobody walks you through this at closing. You get keys, a folder, and a house full of mystery pipes.
caption.shows: A real page from Chapter 1: where the main water shutoff hides, and why you turn it once before you ever need it.
caption.ask: Do you know where your main shutoff is right now? Be honest.
